speaker: cyrus
text: This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.
name: Cyrus king of Persia

speaker: cyrus
text: Whoever among you belongs to His people, may his God be with him, and may he go to Jerusalem in Judah and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel; He is the God who is in Jerusalem.
name: Cyrus king of Persia

speaker: cyrus
text: And let every survivor, wherever he lives, be assisted by the men of that region with silver, gold, goods, and livestock, along with a freewill offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.’
name: Cyrus king of Persia

speaker: levites
text: For He is good; for His loving devotion to Israel endures forever.
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: enemies-of-judah
text: Let us build with you because, like you, we seek your God and have been sacrificing to Him since the time of King Esar-haddon of Assyria, who brought us here.
name: The enemies of Judah

speaker: zerubbabel
text: You have no part with us in building a house for our God, since we alone must build it for the LORD, the God of Israel, as Cyrus king of Persia has commanded us.
name: Zerubbabel, Jeshua and the family heads

speaker: tattenai
text: Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?
name: Tattenai and his associates

speaker: tattenai
text: What are the names of the men who are constructing this building?
name: Tattenai and his associates

speaker: tattenai
text: Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?
name: Tattenai and his associates

speaker: jewish-elders
text: We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and completed.
name: The elders of the Jews

speaker: jewish-elders
text: But since our fathers angered the God of heaven, He delivered them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean who destroyed this temple and carried away the people to Babylon.
name: The elders of the Jews

speaker: jewish-elders
text: In his first year, however, Cyrus king of Babylon issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
name: The elders of the Jews

speaker: jewish-elders
text: He also removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles belonging to the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken and carried there from the temple in Jerusalem. King Cyrus gave these articles to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he appointed governor
name: The elders of the Jews

speaker: jewish-elders
text: and instructed, ‘Take these articles, put them in the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.’
name: The elders of the Jews

speaker: jewish-elders
text: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem, and from that time until now it has been under construction, but it has not yet been completed.
name: The elders of the Jews

speaker: ezra
text: The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: You are holy to the LORD, and these articles are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests, Levites, and heads of the Israelite families.
name: Ezra

speaker: leaders
text: The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.
name: The leaders

speaker: leaders
text: Indeed, the Israelites have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, so that the holy seed has been mixed with the people of the land. And the leaders and officials have taken the lead in this unfaithfulness!
name: The leaders

speaker: ezra
text: O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: From the days of our fathers to this day, our guilt has been great. Because of our iniquities, we and our kings and priests have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the earth and put to the sword and captivity, to pillage and humiliation, as we are this day.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: But now, for a brief moment, grace has come from the LORD our God to preserve for us a remnant and to give us a stake in His holy place. Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but He has extended to us grace in the sight of the kings of Persia, giving us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and giving us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: And now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commandments
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: that You gave through Your servants the prophets, saying: ‘The land that you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the impurity of its peoples and the abominations with which they have filled it from end to end.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: Now, therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Never seek their peace or prosperity, so that you may be strong and may eat the good things of the land, leaving it as an inheritance to your sons forever.’
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: shall we again break Your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who commit these abominations? Would You not become so angry with us as to wipe us out, leaving no remnant or survivor?
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: O LORD, God of Israel, You are righteous! For we remain this day as a remnant. Here we are before You in our guilt, though because of it no one can stand before You.
name: Ezra

speaker: shecaniah
text: We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land, yet in spite of this, there is hope for Israel.
name: Shecaniah son of Jehiel

speaker: shecaniah
text: So now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all the foreign wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the command of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.
name: Shecaniah son of Jehiel

speaker: shecaniah
text: Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action!
name: Shecaniah son of Jehiel

speaker: ezra
text: You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel.
name: Ezra

speaker: ezra
text: Now, therefore, make a confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His will. Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from your foreign wives.
name: Ezra

speaker: assembly
text: Truly we must do as you say!
name: The assembly

speaker: assembly
text: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.
name: The assembly

speaker: assembly
text: Let our leaders represent the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at an appointed time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us.
name: The assembly
